lines.1: I had reached the limit of my patience too.
lines.2: Blood rushed straight to my head.
lines.3: 「I can't keep up with you anymore, Princess!」
lines.5: Once I'd said that much, the momentum carried me into blurting out things I didn't even mean.
lines.6: 「A student talking about subjugation and world conquest is honestly just cringeworthy!」
lines.7: 「You're the one who should be more modest and, you know, ladylike...」
lines.9: 「What's that supposed to mean? That attitude of yours--always looking down on people--needs to change too--」
lines.10: 「Too bad! I liked you quite a bit, Tsushima.」
lines.12: 「The more I liked you, the angrier this makes me.」
